The patch fixes a stack-based buffer overflow in _asn1_ltostr when converting a long to a decimal string. The vulnerability occurs with v == LONG_MIN (or similar edge cases): the statement v = -v; overflows signed arithmetic and leaves v negative. The subsequent do { ... } while (v); loop then produces digits for the negative magnitude, which can generate a string longer than the destination buffers temp and str are sized for. Because the original loop had no upper bound on count, it could write past the end of temp[LTOSTR_MAX_SIZE] and then write the null terminator past the end of the caller’s str buffer.
